title: Liapoldus Core bootstrap core.yaml
description: Минимальная bootstrap-конфигурация Core. Plugin settings и fixed endpoints хранятся в SQLite; оператор вручную запускает Core и plugins. Core не управляет plugin processes или containers.

fileReference.description: External file reference; inline secret values are forbidden.

path.description: Local SQLite database file path; network filesystems are not supported.

clientCA.description: Required for web Controller non-loopback access; desktop uses restricted SSH forwarding to loopback.

tls.description: Management TLS identity is required for every bind. Web Controller traffic additionally uses client mTLS and Bearer service credential.

pluginControl.description: Private Plugin SDK lifecycle/configuration REST listener. Its trust roots are independent from Management and plugin-to-plugin roots.

x-liapoldus-invariants: Core is a single process and SQLite is the only durable source of desired plugin configuration.
Plugin processes and their binaries are operator-managed. Core only connects to fixed registered endpoints and has no process, binary-installation or container-provider management API.
Plugin settings are not accepted in core.yaml, environment variables, argv, or plugin application-config files; plugins pull exact immutable versioned JSON from Core REST after Reload(generation).
Traffic listeners, sites, routes, and traffic-plugin runtime configuration are not part of core.yaml.
Traffic plugins own their runtime state on persistent local storage; Core remains implementation-agnostic.
Local process supervision, signed package installation, container providers and workload automation are deferred to v2.
Management TLS is always enabled. Management and plugin workload trust roots are separate.
Plugin control REST uses the pluginControl TLS files and does not reuse the Management client CA or plugin-to-plugin trust roots.
SQLite and plugin-owned runtime state use persistent local storage; Core has no plugin package cache.
Plaintext secret values are forbidden in core.yaml and plugin settings JSON; secrets are returned only by scoped Core REST grants.
